summary.whatChanges: Fixes wildcard path matching in the LinearRouter and PatternRouter. Suffix wildcards like `/assets*` now match any path starting with that prefix (but not shorter ones), while trailing `/*` matches only at a segment boundary (the bare path or anything after a slash), no longer matching `/pathfoo`. Tests added to the shared router suite.
behaviorChanges: Route `/assets*` now matches `/assets`, `/assets-v2` and `/assets/app.js`, but no longer matches `/asset`
Route `/path/*` matches `/path` and `/path/to/file` but no longer matches `/pathfoo`
PatternRouter builds a different regex suffix (`(?:$|/)`, `''`, or `/?$`) depending on how the path ends
risks: Apps relying on the old loose prefix matching (e.g. `/path/*` catching `/pathfoo`) will now get no match / 404
Only LinearRouter and PatternRouter are updated here; other router implementations in the project may now behave inconsistently unless they already match this semantic
LinearRouter's new endsWithSlashStar branch bypasses the previous trailing-slash tolerance logic, which could change edge cases with trailing slashes
